context.question: Can the logical zero of the 23-qubit quantum Golay code be prepared with at most 43 CNOT gates, on exactly 23 qubits, with free single-qubit Clifford gates, no measurements and no ancillas?
context.locator: Ganesan, Appendix A.4, explicit 43-gate challenge; Open Quantum Problems A50
context.experiment: Reverse a trial 43-gate schedule on the exact target stabilizer. Start with systematic changes to the public 44-gate seed, then search different axes, wire pairs and orders.
context.known: 44 entanglers in six layers is an explicit deposited circuit. The originating agent already tried 43 and reported an unsuccessful 92-million-neighbor delete-two/insert-one screen.
context.scope: One explicitly reconstructed circuit with a signed-stabilizer verification in cyclic coordinates answers yes. A no requires a lower bound over all allowed circuits. Failed local searches establish neither a lower bound nor optimality.
